summary:
Palantir 2026年第二季財報強勁，營收年增近93%，EPS大幅超越市場預期。
• 營收達 19.4 億美元，較去年同期大幅成長 92.83%。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.41 美元，優於預期的 0.35 美元，驚喜幅度達 18.51%。
• 商業與政府業務需求持續擴張，推動整體獲利能力提升。
• 營運規模化效益顯現，毛利率與營業利益率維持健康水準。
ai_view:
觀點：財報數據顯示基本面強健，AI與大數據平台需求超乎預期。短中期來看，極高的本益比意味著市場已預先透支部分成長動能，股價對利多敏感度高但回檔風險亦存。後續追蹤指標應聚焦企業客戶擴張速度、政府合約續約狀況以及利潤率變化。

需留意：目前本益比高達 141.96，估值過高可能放大市場波動風險。；高成長預期若有任何放緩跡象，股價可能面臨劇烈修正壓力。

summary_en:
Palantir reported strong Q2 2026 earnings with revenue surging nearly 93% YoY and EPS beating consensus estimates.
• Revenue reached $1.94 billion, representing a significant 92.83% increase year-over-year.
• EPS came in at $0.41, beating the estimated $0.35 with a surprise of 18.51%.
• Continued expansion in both commercial and government sectors drove overall profitability.
• Operating scale benefits materialized, keeping gross and operating margins healthy.

ai_view_en:
view: Signal is fundamentally robust, with AI and big data platform demand exceeding expectations. Near to mid-term, the lofty P/E ratio implies priced-in growth, making the stock sensitive to positive news but vulnerable to pullbacks. Key metrics to track include enterprise customer acquisition pace, government contract renewals, and margin sustainability.

Watch：A trailing P/E ratio of 141.96 indicates an elevated valuation that could amplify market volatility risks.; Any signs of deceleration in high-growth expectations may lead to sharp stock price corrections.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘與營收皆顯著優於分析師預期，展現強勁成長動能。
